lines: Best placement of the ≥ 1″ area: HRRR (ETS 0.09).
Closest on the peak: REFS LPMM, 2.06″ vs 3.50″ observed at its resolution (59%).
Far too dry overall (under half the observed rain volume): ECMWF IFS 3%, ECMWF AIFS 3%, ECMWF ENS mean 5%, ECMWF ENS P75 6%.
Earliest signal: GEFS max reached half the observed peak 48 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
